label: Covert-channel replay
provenance: Deterministic simulation calibrated to measured hardware: idle 8.7 ns/access, saturated 90.3 ns/access, captured on the study machine (Chromium 152, A18 Pro-class, non-isolated, no SharedArrayBuffer) on 2026-09-12. The replay is a model of those figures, not a raw capture, so the demo is identical on every machine; the live mode is the real thing.

measuredContrast.note: Sustained-contention detection was rock solid at ~10x. Per-bit decoding is the hard part; see BUGS/scoping.
